intro: Bosnian culture mixes Ottoman, Slavic and Central European influences, from coffee and ćevapi to soulful sevdalinka songs.

chapters.title: Songs and stories
text: Sevdalinka are melancholy love songs from Ottoman times. Nobel Prize-winner Ivo Andrić grew up in Bosnia, and the Bosnian film No Man's Land won the Oscar for best foreign-language film in 2002. The Sarajevo Film Festival began in 1995, during the siege.

chapters.title: Food
text: Ćevapi, small grilled meat sausages served in flatbread with onions, and burek, a pastry filled with meat, are national favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: Traditional Bosnian songs of love and longing.
